title: History
subtitle: Every saved version of this project, so you can look back or put things back.
retentionNote: History uses {size} of your storage. Automatic versions expire after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}; named versions are kept until you delete them.
saveHint: Give this moment a name. Named versions are kept until you delete them.
saveFailed: Could not save this version. Try again in a moment.
emptyHint: Save a version to keep this moment. Automatic versions also appear before runs and after a pause.
loadFailed: Could not load the history of this project.
genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

expiry.days: {count, plural, one {expires in # day} other {expires in # days}}

reason.contentGone: The file changed after this version was saved, so its old content is gone.
reason.quarantined: It is quarantined for a safety review.
reason.quarantineMarker: It was quarantined around the time this version was saved.
reason.outputHeld: It is held by a safety review, so its content cannot be shown.
reason.designVersionGone: The design system version it used is gone.
reason.unverified: It can be restored only while the live file stays unchanged.
reason.notYetSupported: Restoring this kind of item is not available yet.
reason.pathTaken: Another file already uses its path.
reason.workflowInvalid: The workflow no longer passes today's checks.
reason.egressConsentReset: A step that sends footage to an outside service was turned off until you allow it again. The restored workflow will ask you again before sending footage to an outside service.
reason.storageQuotaExceeded: There is not enough storage left for this item.
reason.itemNotFound: This item is not in the version.
reason.alreadyCurrent: This design system version is already the current one.
reason.designVersionInvalid: The design system version it used cannot be restored.
reason.timelineInvalid: The timeline no longer passes today's checks.
reason.projectTooLarge: This project has too many files to save as one version.
reason.namedVersionLimit: This project already has the maximum number of named versions. Delete one first.
reason.projectRunActive: A run is using this project. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
reason.workflowRunActive: A run is using this workflow. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
reason.restoreInProgress: Another restore is already running for this project. Try again in a moment.
reason.fileInUseByAvatar: This file is used by an avatar, so it was left as it is. Remove it from the avatar first.
reason.invalidName: A version name must be 1 to 80 characters after trimming and contain no control or format characters.
reason.invalidScope: Choose whether to restore one item or the whole project.
reason.invalidItems: Choose between 1 and 50 items to restore.
reason.invalidItemKind: The item kind is not one this project records.
reason.invalidTarget: Choose a version to compare with, or the project now.
reason.nothingToRestore: There is nothing to restore from this version.
reason.restoreFailed: This item could not be restored. Try again in a moment.
reason.pronunciationEntrySkipped: One pronunciation entry was skipped because it no longer passes today's checks.

detail.changesSummary: {count, plural, one {# item changed} other {# items changed}}, {unchanged, plural, one {# unchanged} other {# unchanged}}
detail.changesTruncated: Only the first 5,000 changes are shown.
detail.deleteForeverHint: Removes this file's content from every version.
detail.noEditPermission: You can view this history, but you need permission to change this project to restore items.
detail.noDeletePermission: Only an owner, an administrator or the person who created the project can restore the whole project.

diff.title: Changes to {name}

diff.tooLarge: This file is too large to compare line by line. Size changed from {from} to {to}.
diff.timelineSummary: Revision {fromRevision} to {toRevision}. Tracks {fromTracks} to {toTracks}, clips {fromClips} to {toClips}, {fromFrames} to {toFrames} frames.

restore.itemIntro: This puts {name} back the way it was in this version.
restore.projectIntro: This puts the whole project back the way it was in this version.
restore.previewFailed: Could not check what will change.
restore.estimate: About {size} will be added to your storage.
restore.safety: A safety version, {name}, was saved first, so you can undo this.
restore.blockedCount: {count, plural, one {# item cannot be restored} other {# items cannot be restored}}

delete.versionMessage: Version {number} ({label}) and everything it holds will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.fileMessage: The content of {name} will be removed from every version. The versions stay, but this file can never be restored from them.
